decisions.statement: A line the log page refuses lands in the file instead rather than being lost.
The seat whose page holds a source's lines is looked for again until it is found.
A seat that cannot be looked for at all is a seat not found yet.
A line written before that seat is found lands in the file.
A refusal is said in the name of the source whose lines were refused.
A page refusing lines is said once rather than on every line that page refuses.
Lines written before the agent was known are carried into the agent's own log.
A log at its ceiling is rotated rather than grown.
A console this installs never throws, whatever the sink beneath it does.
A line the sink throws over is written to standard error instead.
A line standard error throws over is dropped rather than thrown on.
A writer that cannot be made yet is a seat not found yet.
A line the log file will not take is written to standard error.

definition: console lines sent to a seat's log page, and to a file until that page can take them
